title: Bundled contract — Heron Systems
instructions: On October 1, Year 1, Heron Systems signed a contract to deliver equipment, install it, and provide 12 months of monitoring service for a total price of **$144,000**, paid in full on October 1. Heron's year-end is December 31.

exhibits.title: Contract details
exhibits.content:
- Equipment delivered and control transferred **October 1, Year 1**. Standalone selling price (SSP): **$120,000**.
- Installation (routinely performed by other vendors) completed **October 15, Year 1**. SSP: **$20,000**.
- Monitoring service runs **October 1, Year 1 – September 30, Year 2**, provided evenly. SSP: **$40,000**.
- A standard 90-day warranty assures the equipment meets agreed specifications; it is not sold separately.

parts.prompt: Is each promise a separate performance obligation?

rows.label: Equipment
rows.explanation: The customer can benefit from it, and it is separately identifiable.

rows.label: Installation
rows.explanation: Other vendors can perform it; it does not significantly modify the equipment.

rows.label: Monitoring service
rows.explanation: A distinct service provided over time.

rows.label: 90-day warranty
rows.explanation: An assurance-type warranty is accounted for under ASC 460 (cost accrual), not as a performance obligation.

rows.label: Transaction price allocated to the equipment
Contract liability, December 31, Year 1
rows.explanation: Cash received 144,000 − revenue 120,000 = **24,000** (9 months of monitoring).
